title: Apollo 11 Saturn V Launch Camera E-8
summary: Raw 500 fps footage from Camera E-8 on the launch tower for the Apollo 11 Saturn V liftoff, transferred in HD from the 16mm original. More than eight minutes of film covers about 30 seconds of real time.
why: HN commenters recommend it for its slow-motion view of the first seconds of liftoff and cite it when comparing launch pads and engine behavior.

quote.text: It explains the sequence of events over the course of 8+ minutes (30 seconds real time).
